contradictions.what: Rep first names CTO Raj as the final decider, then says Angela (COO) signed with Adyen and retreats to 'Probably Angela'.
Rep says we were ahead before the workshop, yet customer questions had already shifted to stores (11 of 14), where we were weak.
Raj is described as the contact 'the whole way' and the decider, but the actual signer, Angela, was met only once.
Rep says Raj wanted us, yet the signer chose Adyen; Raj's preference is based only on Raj's own statement and the rep hedges with 'I think'.
